truth_precedence.central_adjudication: resolves only observed human disagreements after both independent files are frozen
truth_precedence.risk_construction_intent: sampling and sensitivity diagnostic only; never overrides human judgment
truth_precedence.old_llm_judgments: kept closed until both human files and any adjudication are frozen
truth_precedence.adjudicated_agreement: never reported as pre-adjudication inter-rater agreement

quality.score_difference_gt_1: central adjudication required; within-one scores are averaged
quality.failure: quality human construct not stable; do not qualify an LLM quality proxy

function.failure: function codebook remains ambiguous; stop fresh development wave

risk.failure: risk human construct not stable; risk requires direct human measurement

quality.use_if_pass: development-scale absolute Quality proxy with frozen human audit; sealed claims retain human sampling

function.component_results: reported separately; no overall pass may hide a component below 4/6
function.use_if_pass: mechanism diagnostic only, never the causal value label

risk.use_if_pass: ordinary development screening only; all LLM disagreements and severity >=2 remain human-reviewed
risk.failure: LLM risk is not a gold proxy; use human labels for all risk claims

aggregation.quality: average two human scores when within one point; adjudicate only axis differences greater than one or unresolved
aggregation.function: FUNCTIONAL iff contribution, required act, and candidate boundary are all YES; any NO is NONFUNCTIONAL; any UNRESOLVED is UNRESOLVED
aggregation.risk: material iff any human-confirmed event severity >=2; critical iff severity=3
aggregation.missing: never zero-impute or convert to OFF/safe/nonfunctional
aggregation.grain: human reviewer and adjudicator are repeated measurements, not independent states
